name: agency-specialists
description: Reusable specialist workflows for code review, UX research, content strategy, and coordinating multi-role project work.

interface.longDescription: A curated set of repeatable specialist workflows adapted from The Agency: code review, UX research planning, content campaign planning, and multi-role project runbooks. Skills use tools available in the current ChatGPT or Codex host and do not require a bundled remote service. Repository edits and other consequential actions remain subject to user authorization.
capabilities: Review code for correctness, security, maintainability, performance, and test gaps.
Plan ethical, evidence-led UX research and usability studies.
Create audience-focused content strategies and multi-channel campaign plans.
Coordinate multi-role project workflows with explicit phases, deliverables, and quality gates.
defaultPrompt: Review this code for correctness, security risks, and missing tests.
Create a UX research plan for validating this product idea.
Build a content campaign plan for this audience and goal.
